Contributors: Bowen, Thomas, -1790; Speer, Joseph Smith

Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Depths shown by soundings. Shows southern United States, Mexico, Central America, West Indies, Bermudas, and northern South America. European possessions shown by color. Includes acknowledgement to Captain Speer by "John Pownall, secry., Plantation Office, Whitehall, January 25, 1774" and "Honorary gold medal." Scale ca. 1:5,000,000. LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, 1700 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2: 100; 651/1; 651/2
